entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Saint Theodoret of Antioch or Saint Theodoritus of Uzès was a Greek-speaking Syrian Christian priest who died a martyr in Antioch during the reign of Emperor Julian the Apostate. His life is recorded only by apologetic works. His relics were later taken to Uzès in the south of France and placed in the cathedral, which is dedicated to him.
